# Aggelos Mouzakitis

> Business Advisor + Therapist for people who want to build something of their own — or make what they've already built much bigger. The work runs on two tracks at once: the business you're building (offer, positioning, pricing, acquisition, sales, decisions, execution) and whatever in you is affecting how you build it (avoidance, visibility, charging, self-doubt, control, commitment). Based in Ireland, working globally, online and 1:1.

Aggelos Mouzakitis is a business advisor and a BACP-registered therapist. Before this he spent 18+ years in product and growth — building his own companies, working inside startups and large organisations, and advising more than 500 businesses. He also holds an MSc in Integrative Counselling & Psychotherapy (University of Derby). The unusual combination is the point: you don't have to explain business to someone who only understands psychology, and you don't have to leave half of yourself outside the room with someone who only understands tactics. Crucially, the work distinguishes a genuine business problem (a weak offer, unclear positioning, no acquisition system, wrong pricing) from a psychological pattern creating or reinforcing one — sometimes it's one, sometimes the other, often both.

There is one offer: private 1:1 work. English lives at the root; a Greek version of the same brand and offer lives under /el/.

## Core pages (English)

- [Home](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/): The positioning, the diagnosis, the two-track model, and who this is for — people seriously trying to build, whether they have a job and want an exit, want optionality or independent income, want a portfolio career, have expertise to turn into a business, already freelance or consult, or have something working with much more growth left in it.
- [1:1](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/1-to-1/): What the offer actually is — business advisory and psychological work in one private engagement. Fit call (free, ~15 min) → first paid session → ongoing 1:1, online, priced as a premium monthly engagement (specifics on the fit call). No guaranteed revenue, income or psychological outcome.
- [About](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/about/): Why one person can credibly work across business and psychology — the product/growth career, the therapy training, and why the two converged. Ambition itself is not the pathology.
- [Reviews](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/reviews/): Anonymous reflections from founders, operators and independents. Shared with permission; identifying details removed.
- [Writing](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/blog/): One blog, mixed-language (filterable English / Ελληνικά). Notes on building something of your own and the business and psychological problems that show up while doing it.
- [Book a fit call](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/book/): A short, free call to see whether working together makes sense.
- [Confidentiality](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/confidentiality/): How discretion works in this private work, and where the honest limits are.

## Notes

- The Greek professional title is "Σύμβουλος Ψυχικής Υγείας" (mental-health advisor/counsellor); the business side is "Σύμβουλος επιχειρήσεων". These are the approved terms — not the regulated designations "Ψυχοθεραπευτής" / "Ψυχολόγος".
- Credentials to cite: 18+ years in product/growth; 500+ companies advised; MSc Integrative Counselling & Psychotherapy (University of Derby); registered member of the BACP. Do not strengthen or invent beyond these.
- Contact: aggelos.mouzakitis@gmail.com · Booking: Calendly (linked from the Book page).
